title: Adjectives and the partitive review
focus: Retrieve the taught partitive patterns in mixed practice.

exercises.prompt: Complete “I am looking for a new book.” Etsin ____ kirjaa.
exercises.explanation: An adjective directly describing this singular partitive noun also takes singular partitive. Agreement means matching the noun’s case and number. uusi uses uut- + -ta, written uutta; keep the long uu.
exercises.misconceptionCategory: Singular adjective agreement in partitive: form or use confused

optionFeedback.uutta: An adjective directly describing this singular partitive noun also takes singular partitive. Agreement means matching the noun’s case and number. uusi uses uut- + -ta, written uutta; keep the long uu.
optionFeedback.uusi: uusi is not the required partitive form for this meaning. An adjective directly describing this singular partitive noun also takes singular partitive. Agreement means matching the noun’s case and number.
optionFeedback.uusia: uusia does not express the requested case and number here. uusi uses uut- + -ta, written uutta; keep the long uu.
